program.major: Black Diaspora and African American Studies
program.department: Black Diaspora and African American Studies

notes: Verified against the UC San Diego catalog page (catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/BDAAS.html). 52 total units (13 four-unit courses). The major requires choosing one of three concentrations: A (Africa and the Black Diaspora), B (African American Studies), or C (Interdisciplinary Study, which draws electives from both A and B). Lower-division core and the six upper-division discipline electives depend on the chosen concentration. Up to two outside courses may be petitioned. Independent study 197/198/199 is P/NP only; at most one P/NP course may count. Cross-listed course codes are listed under both subject prefixes. CORRECTION: PH 157 was removed from the Human Research Methodology bucket - on the catalog page PH 157 (Intersectionality and Public Health) appears only under Concentration A electives, not the research methods list; it remains correctly present in the Concentration A bucket.

buckets.label: Lower-Division Core Course (choose 1, per concentration)
buckets.note: Concentration A: choose from AAS 11, AAS 14, AAS 15. Concentration B: choose from AAS 10, AAS 11, AAS 15. Concentration C: choose from any A or B option. AAS 10/R and AAS 11/R have writing-variant sections. Verified against catalog.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Core Courses (all required)
buckets.note: All four required (16 units). AAS 170 = Legacies of Research on Disenfranchised Communities (has /R variant); AAS 171 = Service Learning in Nonprofits; AAS 172 = Scholarly Work Practicum; AAS 179 = BDAAS Capstone. Verified against catalog.

buckets.label: Human Research Methodology (choose 1)
buckets.note: One UC San Diego human research methods course from the approved list. Cross-listed on the catalog as ETHN 107/197, USP 129/ETHN 107, USP 130/ETHN 107. PH 157 was REMOVED here - it is not on the catalog's research methods list (it appears under Concentration A electives instead).

buckets.label: Upper-Division Discipline Electives — Concentration A (Africa and the Black Diaspora): choose 6
buckets.note: Six upper-division electives from the Concentration A list. All codes verified against catalog (cross-listed pairs on the page include ANSC 185/AAS 185, ETHN 178/R/MUS 126, ETHN 108/MUS 151, ETHN 128/MUS 152, CGS 114/ETHN 183, USP 104/ETHN 105, USP 107/POLI 102E, USP 132/ETHN 188, USP 133/SOCI 152, USP 105/SOCI 153). PH 157 (Intersectionality and Public Health) is correctly listed here.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Discipline Electives — Concentration B (African American Studies): choose 6
buckets.note: Six upper-division electives from the Concentration B list. All codes verified against catalog (cross-listed pairs on the page include AAS 185/ANSC 185, EDS 117/SOCI 117, EDS 126/SOCI 126, ETHN 159/HIUS 183, ETHN 164/MUS 153, ETHN 172/LTEN 183, ETHN 174/LTEN 185, ETHN 175/LTEN 186, HIUS 139/ETHN 149, HIUS 148/USP 103).

buckets.label: Upper-Division Discipline Electives — Concentration C (Interdisciplinary Study): choose 6
buckets.note: Concentration C draws its six upper-division discipline electives from the approved courses in both Concentration A and Concentration B (see those two buckets for the full combined course list). No separate distinct list is published in the catalog. Verified against catalog. Concentration C has no separate published list; per the catalog (catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/BDAAS.html) and the file's own verified note, it draws its six upper-division discipline electives from the combined approved courses of Concentration A and Concentration B. Courses below are the deduplicated union of the fully-populated A and B buckets in this same file. Note SOCI 187 (from A) and SOCI 187E (from B) are distinct entries, both retained. Cross-listed pairs already reflected in the source buckets.
